title: Completed COST ESTIMATING WORKSHEET Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed COST ESTIMATING WORKSHEET artifact data payloads (PMO-04.04.03).

role_title_and_headcount.description: Specific resource role, staffing level, and number of full-time equivalents (FTE).

hours_allocation_and_hourly_rate.description: Total planned working hours and authorized standard or contracted hourly billing rate.

total_calculated_labor_cost.description: Subtotal labor expenditure calculated from hours multiplied by hourly rate.

material_or_equipment_item_description.description: Detailed description of physical supplies, hardware, server infrastructure, or licenses.

unit_quantity_and_unit_purchase_price.description: Required quantity and current quoted unit price per item.

total_calculated_materials_cost.description: Subtotal materials expenditure calculated from quantity multiplied by unit price.

contracted_service_or_work_package.description: External vendor scope of work, milestone deliverables, or consulting package.

vendor_pricing_model_and_contract_sum.description: Fixed price, time-and-materials rate, or contracted service sum.

grand_total_base_estimate.description: Sum of all labor, materials, equipment, and subcontractor cost line items.

worksheet_verification_and_audit_sign_of.description: Formal reconciliation verifying math accuracy and absence of duplicated cost items.
